steps: Check Order Status with orderNumber and the guest email
Set return quantity 5 for the simple product row and the configurable variant row; line totals shown
stateChanges: Return submitted for the guest order (created-by-test)
evidence: No dependsOn: the class runs by priority and shares the class field orderNumber. Methods 1-3 (priority 1-10, named 'ForRetailUser') sign in with the sheet account returnOrderGuestUserTest, place an order and work on it; methods 4-10 (priority 15-45) place a guest order and work on it. First method captures: method 1 declares the retail chain's records, method 4 (returnOrderForGuestUserVerifyCreateReturnButtonVisibleAfterTrackingOrder) the guest chain's; later methods read the class fields (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when null).

HEAD RECORD VALUES (first method captures): simpleProductDetails/ProductName/AddonCheckboxAsOptional -> product.name and configurableProductInformation/ProductName/z-2510001 -> configurable.variant1Name of the guest head; recorded here as expected-output copies (chain rule confirmed by the user 2026-11-10); the migrated method reads the class fields.
AddToCartQuantity 5 (return quantity = ordered quantity) -> config; guest email (shippingAddressDetails/EmailAddress) -> created-by-test; submitReturnMessage is UI text -> expected-output.

REVIEW (Create Return, order eligibility): the order is placed by the test (created-by-test) and Check Order Status must offer Create Return on it. On atstage Create Return was NOT offered on freshly placed orders (Playwright my-account order-history step 6 parked and order create-return known failure, memory 2026-11-02/04: shown when the store's EnableReturnRequest is on, enabled by Znode_GetValidateReturnOrderProduct line states/RMA window). This is not data the resolver can supply; the proposed STORE_WEBSTORE_RETURNS_ENABLED key (deferred by the user 2026-11-04) would only check the store setting.

returnsStore: STORE_WEBSTORE_RETURNS_ENABLED {store MaxwellsHardware} (new key, pending, user decision 2026-11-11): the store must serve a webstore and have the store global attribute EnableReturnRequest (ZnodeGlobalAttribute 1076) = true, the setting that makes Create Return available. It guarantees the store setting only; whether the order this test places is eligible (line states SHIPPED/SUBMITTED, RMA window, not already returned; Znode_GetValidateReturnOrderProduct) is decided per order and is NOT guaranteed.
